scope: Actual Gerber copper minus actual drilled apertures, source-net labeling (each NC pad separately isolated), joined only by matching plated drills and positive-length actual copper contact at each actual drill wall; all four copper layers checked against native keepouts and 0.30mm board edge. Runtime POURED ignored.
limits: This checks ideal CAM geometry, not fabricated copper continuity, plating thickness, solder joints, thermal performance, impedance, or circuit function.
Net labels and pad membership are taken from the native design; independent SCH/PCB netlist equivalence remains required.
Curve approximation error 0.00001mm; drill Hausdorff tolerance 0.00015mm; no copper-gap bridging is applied.
